observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability intelligence, owner trace, and service-accountability projection

outcome.effectiveness_assessment: The existing exact service-execution join now carries validated owner-process resource evidence into full ECI activity groups and a compact response summary. Duplicate uncertainty text is compacted so the resource relationship survives the tested 8 KB output budget. This improves inspectability of environmental work and cost context; it does not demonstrate service fulfillment, lower cost, or reduced agent intervention.
outcome.interpretation_limit: A future ordinary owner execution with matching scoped service events is required before the projection can be read back with live per-owner cost evidence.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Correlated ambient service activity does not expose owner resource costs
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability intelligence and ambient owner traces
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Capability invocation groups and owner resource deltas existed in related but separate ECI and trace records.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Use the exact service execution identity to correlate the validated resource sample with agent-facing ambient activity, keeping the compact projection bounded and explicit about attribution limits.

improvement_relation.basis: The regression path joins scoped service events to the exact trace execution identity, validates the process-resource record, preserves partial and unavailable measurement state, and retains a bounded cost summary under the ECI response budget.
not_measured: A fresh operational owner resource sample correlated with capability events.
Child-process or host-wide resource consumption attributable to service work.
Whether an environmental service fulfilled an agent's need or reduced manual orchestration.
Whether service latency, resource consumption, or intervention burden improved.
Whether the observed process activity had any relationship to filesystem metadata pressure.

measurement_limits: The implementation and fixture relationship passed verification, but a live matching owner trace has not been observed.
Process counters are correlated to an owner interval, not proven to be caused by one service call.
Service fulfillment, agent receipt, burden reduction, and long-term effectiveness remain unmeasured.
